title: Biased view of a cube function
statement: For a natural number $n$, a real parameter $p$ with $0<p<1$, and a real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, its biased view is the function on $n$-tuples of signs given by the same values as $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
